name: XR1
summary: XR1 is a wheeled humanoid robot from Zhicheng AI for industrial material handling and repetitive work. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base, a vertical lift structure and two articulated arms with grippers. The manufacturer positions it for automotive parts, logistics and electronics production and describes hot-swappable batteries and integration with its AI models. Current commercial shipment availability is unverified.
